messages.s4b1ee84f06d87afc: Located 60 kilometers off the southern tip of Kagoshima, Yakushima rises from the Kuroshio Current in a nearly perfect circle. In the center of the island stands the highest peak in Kyushu, Miyanoura-dake with an altitude of 1,936 meters. Writer Fumiko Hayashi wrote in "Floating Clouds": "It rains thirty-five days a month on Yakushima." The abundant water vapor condenses into fog on the barren granite ridges, causing the growth of the cedar trees to be extremely slow and the resin content to be extremely high, creating the "Yakusugi" that has been incorruptible for thousands of years.

messages.s3f362c37fefde439: 🎌【Essential memorandum before setting off for self-driving in Japan ｜ Japan Travel News Pre-departure information compilation】 ========================================= 1. 🪪 Document list: - Taiwanese passengers: original physical copy of Taiwan driver's license + original Japanese translation from the inspection station + original passport (IDP issued by Taiwan does not apply to this alternative method; other driver's licenses are subject to the regulations of the place of issuance) - Visitors from Hong Kong and Macau: International Driving License (IDP 1949 Convention) + Original local driving license + Original passport 2. 💳 ETC and tolls: - Rent an ETC card when picking up the car (slow down to 20km/h at the gate to pass) 3. ⛽ Refueling points: - For gasoline vehicles, add "Regular" (レギュラー, red oil gun)", do not add the wrong diesel oil! 4. 🛑 Important traffic regulations: - A complete stop must be made in front of the railway level crossing, and the left and right and train dynamics must be confirmed to be safe before passing - Right-turning vehicles must give way to oncoming through traffic and left-turning vehicles - Illegal parking on the roadside is strictly prohibited, and the violation penalties and amounts vary according to the type of violation, vehicle type and procedure 5. 🆘 Emergency SOP: - Alarm: 110 | Ambulance: 119 | Roadside Assistance: #8139 - In the event of an accident, you should call the police and contact the car rental company, and keep the necessary records; claims and deductibles are still determined according to the contract. ========================================= Source: "JAPAN TABI" Japan Self-Driving Guide

messages.sa0dd8b584ecee4fd: 🎌【Essential memorandum before setting off for self-driving in Japan ｜ Japan Travel News Pre-departure information compilation】 ========================================= 1. 🪪 Document list: - Taiwanese passengers: original physical copy of Taiwan driver's license + original Japanese translation from the inspection station + original passport (IDP issued by Taiwan does not apply to this alternative method; other driver's licenses are subject to the regulations of the place of issuance) - Visitors from Hong Kong and Macau: International Driving License (IDP 1949 Convention) + Original local driving license + Original passport 2. 💳 ETC and tolls: - Rent an ETC card when picking up the car (slow down to 20km/h at the gate to pass) 3. ⛽ Refueling points: - For gasoline vehicles, add "Regular" (レギュラー, red oil gun)", do not add the wrong diesel oil! 4. 🛑 Important traffic regulations: - A complete stop must be made in front of the railway level crossing, and the left and right and train dynamics must be confirmed to be safe before passing - Right-turning vehicles must give way to oncoming through traffic and left-turning vehicles - Illegal parking on the roadside is strictly prohibited, and the violation penalties and amounts vary according to the type of violation, vehicle type and procedure 5. 🆘 Emergency SOP: - Alarm: 110 | Ambulance: 119 | Roadside Assistance: #8139 - In the event of an accident, you should call the police and contact the car rental company, and keep the necessary records; claims and deductibles are still determined according to the contract. ========================================= Source: "JAPAN TABI" Japan Self-Driving Guide ZXQVAR0QXZ
